long_biography.plain_text:
Belgian business owner Luc van Onckelen retained his investment in Begetube through a reorganisation of its Italian manufacturing partnership. In 2021, the company sold its substantial interest in IVAR to the Bertolotti family's holding company. Van Onckelen and fellow shareholder Jerry De Weerdt stayed invested in the Belgian operation to support its further development in the Benelux.

The business couples product distribution with detailed help for installers. Its calculation department prepares project estimates, pipe layouts and technical advice, while a laying service can arrange installation. Begetube also develops ventilation components in house, aiming to reduce the number of parts needed for a complete system.
